intro.text: A bandit in the Roughs, counted among the greatest of his day.

items.text: Wax went after Taraco for a petty reason: the bandit had robbed a cobbler days before, and Wax hoped the job would get him new boots. Most people thought Wax was avenging a Faradana lawkeeper whom Taraco had shot the week before, but Wax learned of that killing only after bringing him in.
Wax told Marasi the real story to show her that his heroics looked quite different from the inside.
